notes.title: New patch 1.3 uploaded & it's Halloween!
notes.content:
Greetings noarics! [b]What a horrible night to have patch...[/b]

We bring you this cursed update to get terrified by these new features:
[list]
[*]Autosave system: Every time that the game load a scene or you reach a campfire, the game is automatically saved, you can continue from the new option from the main menu.

[*]Skins system: It includes a new system that allow players to change the appearance of the main characters. At the moment, you can enjoy their original clothes and the Halloween ones.

[*]New world HUD: New contextual helpers will appear if you stand still for a short period of time.
[/list]
But this is not the only thing that we've been working on, if you want to know more, don't forget to read the changelog thread:
[url]https://steamcommunity.com/app/752560/discussions/0/1735463620102108446/[/url]

And don't forget to tell your friends that [b]Noahmund is 20% off[/b] for Halloween!

We will be back... [b]Mwahahahahaha![/b]

notes.title: Critical patch 1.2.1 uploaded!
notes.content:
Hello noarics!

This is a critical patch for 1.2 that fixes some bugs:

· Fixed a bug that freezes the game after the first tutorial.
· Fixed a bug that freezes controller after first chest with Stalos.
· Fixed the new HUD improvement.

So, thank you all, and sorry for the troubles!

See you next time, noarics!

notes.title: New patch 1.2 uploaded!
notes.content:
Hello community, how are you doing?! We’ve been working on a new patch to fix some bugs you’ve been encountered through Noahmund.

There are two big majors changes that you have to know about:

[b]· We added a new calibration system, so, for those players that could not play with a specific controller, now you have the option to calibrate it yourself based on the Xbox layout controller.[/b]

[b]· We fixed a major bug that impedes players to save after a conversation at Crystal Laboratory, but we strongly recommend to start a new game, because it is possible that your saved game file miss some conversations in the future.[/b]

If you want to know more about what have changed on this patch, you should check our changelog thread!

[url=steamcommunity.com/app/752560/discussions/0/1735463620102108446/][/url]

Thank you, and see you soon, noarics!

notes.title: New patch 1.1 uploaded!
notes.content:
Hello noarics, have you been playing Noahmund? We have to thank you for your welcome on Steam!

This is our first patch that fixes some errors, but the most important one is about Cinematic Audio, now you can hear them from the first time even if you didn’t set your language options!

So, if you want to know more about this patch, check our changelog thread:

[url=steamcommunity.com/app/752560/discussions/0/1735463620098880213/][/url]

See you soon noarics!
